attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited published an advertisement in The Economic Times, Business Standard, and Mumbai Lakshadweep on 13th November 2026. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations Regulations 2015. The advertisement contains Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results. These results are for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The information is also available on the company website at www.alkemlabs.com.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited has made the audio recording of its Q2 and H1FY2027 Earnings Conference Call available on its website. The recording can be accessed at https://www.alkemlabs.com/investors/earnings-call. This filing is submitted in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued on 12th November, 2026. It was signed by Manish Narang, President – Legal, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer. The company scrip symbol is ALKEM.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited intimates the opening of its trading window on 16th November, 2026. This follows the communication of financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The trading window was previously closed starting from 29th September, 2026. The closure lasted until 48 hours after the results were shared with the stock exchanges. The company confirms that the results have now been communicated. Consequently, the window opens on 16th November, 2026. This notice is addressed to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The intimation is signed by Manish Narang, President Legal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories reported standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors took record of these results at its meeting held in Mumbai on November 12, 2026. Total revenue from operations was 45,520 million rupees, representing year-on-year growth of 13.8 percent. Net profit after non-controlling interest was 6,753 million rupees, showing a year-on-year decline of 11.7 percent. EBITDA stood at 10,252 million rupees with a margin of 22.5 percent. Net cash was 49,054 million rupees as of September 30, 2026. Dr. Amrut Naik was appointed as Chief Executive Officer. The company also announced a conference call for investors and analysts on November 12, 2026, at 4:30 pm IST.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Gopal Kothari as Chief Financial Officer of the Company w.e.f. December 02, 2026.
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited has appointed Mr. Gopal Kothari as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel. The Board of Directors approved this appointment on 12th November 2026, following recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and approval from the Audit Committee. Mr. Kothari assumes the role with effect from 02nd December 2026. His contract duration is tied to his continued employment with the Company. Mr. Kothari is a qualified Chartered Accountant and Company Secretary with over 24 years of experience in financial planning, cash flow management, and taxation. He holds a B. Com. Honours degree. The company disclosed this information under SEBI Listing Regulations. The details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November, 2026. The Board approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, was Rs. 45,519.9 million, compared to Rs. 40,009.9 million in the corresponding previous period. For the six months ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 82,921.4 million. The profit for the period for the quarter was Rs. 6,671.3 million, while for the six-month period, it was Rs. 11,881.1 million. Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued an Independent Auditor's Review Report confirming that the financial results do not contain any material misstatement. The meeting commenced at 11.30 a.m. and concluded at 01.40 p.m.

attchmntText: Alkem Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of incorporation of subsidiary in the form of Joint Venture.
voiceSummary: Alkem Laboratories Limited incorporated a subsidiary named Alkem Pharma Company, Limited Liability Company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on 8th November, 2026. This entity operates as a Joint Venture in the pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals industry. The company holds a 51% stake in the subsidiary. The total capital of the new entity is 7,500,000.0 SAR, divided into 75,000.0 shares of 100 SAR each. Alkem Laboratories subscribed to 38,250 shares, amounting to 3,825,000.00 SAR. The investment is a strategic move to expand business and market reach in Saudi Arabia. The subsidiary will handle the manufacture, import, marketing, and distribution of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. The transaction is not a related party transaction. No promoter group has an interest in the entity.
